title: Witch in Purple Apothecary
description: A mystical woman with purple hair and ornate blue and red robes stands in a magical apothecary, gazing into a glowing golden orb held in her hands. The scene is viewed through a worn purple wooden window frame with a green velvet curtain, revealing shelves of glowing blue potions, hanging spell tags, an open spellbook with a green wreath and frog, a lit candle, and scattered rune stones.
prompt: A mystical witch with curly purple hair and ornate blue-red robes stands inside a whimsical apothecary, holding a glowing golden orb and looking into it. The view is framed by an old purple wooden window with peeling paint and a rich green velvet curtain tied with a red ribbon. Inside, there are shelves filled with glowing blue potions and red roses, hanging paper spell tags, an open ancient book with a green wreath and a small green frog on its pages, a lit purple candle, scales, and scattered white rune stones on the counter. Warm magical lighting, highly detailed fantasy illustration.
